This is the key issue! Let me check if the gateway is using subPath in its volume mount. Looking back at the pod details, I can see:

```
"volume_mounts": [{"name": "limits", "mountPath": "/etc/gateway/limits.yaml", "subPath": "limits.yaml", ...}]
```

The gateway pods are mounted with a **subPath**. According to the Kubernetes documentation, when a ConfigMap is consumed as a subPath volume mount, the pod **will not receive ConfigMap updates**. Let me search for more documentation to confirm this behavior.
